issues.description: Class Lecture constructor parameter order is inconsistent between the problem statement's UML/instructions and the provided solution. The problem statement (UML and constructor instructions) requires the constructor parameters to follow the UML attribute order: numberOfInscribedStudents, lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfTutors (see UML attribute listing). The solution's constructor signature is: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 13). This mismatch contradicts the explicit instruction in the exercise text to follow the UML order and may confuse students about the expected constructor signature and the tests they should satisfy.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Change the solution constructor to match the UML/instruction order: public Lecture(int numberOfInscribedStudents, String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfTutors) and reorder attribute declarations accordingly; update the solution code and any example usages. Or (B) Update the problem statement (text and UML) to reflect the solution's chosen order (lectureName first) and clarify the constructor signature in the task description. Also update the template TODOs and any tests to reflect the chosen canonical order so students and automated checks are aligned.
